evidence.finding: CLI and native MCP share scoped history, route and continuation operations with bearer credentials.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/routes.py

evidence.finding: Continuations persist successor sequences and bind execution to the original owner, scope and completion.

evidence.finding: Single-use pairing credentials expire after five minutes and paired device sessions after 30 days; host control uses a separate bearer secret.

evidence.locator: record_grant, scope_for, begin_review, finish_review and publication/reconciliation

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/worktree.py
evidence.locator: ensure_worktree, setup/sync paths and dependency symlink helpers
evidence.finding: Optional turn isolation materializes separate working directories, records sync outcomes and links configured dependency directories. This is code isolation, not an OS sandbox.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/topic_queue.py
evidence.finding: Session turns queue per topic/agent, independent ad hoc turns start separately, and server workers own completion and sync.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/memory.py
evidence.finding: Topic memory is a local Markdown document with YAML front matter, code-root scope and content-revision hashes.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/turn_context.py
evidence.finding: Context references retain original-request and prior-result message IDs and record whether each source was injected or already in resumed history.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/watch_service.py
evidence.finding: Watch observation and execution have separate enablement and credentials; dispatch belongs to the server.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/watch_policy.py
evidence.finding: Watch policy bounds polling, lifetime, runs and attempts. Execution is off by default and topic policy can only narrow global policy.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/dependency_sync.py
evidence.finding: Host-authorized dependency operations run locked uv sync, npm ci or frozen pnpm install with a 600-second limit and bounded output.

evidence.title: agent-squid agent/server.py
evidence.finding: The server exposes authenticated chat, process/queue control, file and diff views and persisted outcomes after browser disconnect.

changes.summary: Atomic revision 2 adds the OWN-03 telemetry off-switch question. Integration preparation repeated a bounded scan of the pinned public source with named paths and search terms (telemetry-code-scan) and found no ADE-vendor usage, diagnostic or crash sender, so the default is no telemetry and the off-switch location stays unknown. Other OWN-03 atomic answers are kept from agent:ADE-193-source; the claim awaits a new independent review.

before.telemetry_defaults: Search of agent/, ui/app.js, ui/index.html and pyproject.toml for telemetry, PostHog, Sentry ingestion, Mixpanel, Amplitude and google-analytics found no outbound product analytics integration or telemetry opt-out/consent flow. Native usage analytics is local; optional Shore audit export is explicit remote transport, not covered by this absence.

after.telemetry_defaults: No ADE telemetry by default in the pinned public host and browser UI: a bounded scan of agent/, ui/, bin/, config/, release/, scripts/, tools/ and pyproject.toml for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment, Sentry, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Bugsnag, Datadog and crash-reporting terms found no ADE-vendor usage, diagnostic or crash sender; vendored UI bundle matches are not analytics integrations. Local usage statistics stay in SQLite, and the Shore audit export goes only to a relay the operator configures, so neither is default vendor telemetry.
after.telemetry_off_switch: Not applicable: the bounded scan found no ADE-vendor telemetry sender in the scoped public source, so there is nothing to switch off and no off-switch location is recorded. Absence of a sender is not a closed-service or private-build promise; external CLI/provider telemetry and task-data transport have their own controls.
